title.it: La formazione delle parole: unhappy, happiness

goal.sl: Iz ene besede narediš več: nasprotja (unhappy, impossible), samostalnike (kindness, decision), pridevnike (careful, careless) in cele družine besed, kot jih sprašuje B2 First.
goal.de: Aus einem Wort machst du mehrere: Gegenteile (unhappy, impossible), Nomen (kindness, decision), Adjektive (careful, careless) und ganze Wortfamilien, wie B2 First sie abfragt.
goal.it: Da una parola ne fai altre: contrari (unhappy, impossible), nomi (kindness, decision), aggettivi (careful, careless) e intere famiglie di parole, come chiede il B2 First.
goal.en: You can make more words from one: opposites (unhappy, impossible), nouns (kindness, decision), adjectives (careful, careless) and whole families of words, as B2 First asks.

say.sl: **happy → unhappy.** (srečen → nesrečen) **un-** in **dis-** pomenita »ne«, drugega se ne spremeni: **unkind** (neprijazen), **unlucky** (nesrečen); **disagree** (ne strinjati se), **dislike** (ne marati), **dishonest** (nepošten). **disappear** (izginiti) je le še ena beseda z **dis-**. Kateri je pravi, se naučiš z besedo.
say.de: **happy → unhappy.** (glücklich → unglücklich) **un-** und **dis-** bedeuten „nicht“, sonst ändert sich nichts: **unkind** (unfreundlich), **unlucky** (glücklos); **disagree** (nicht einverstanden sein), **dislike** (nicht mögen), **dishonest** (unehrlich). **disappear** (verschwinden) ist noch ein Wort mit **dis-**. Welches passt, lernst du mit dem Wort.
say.it: **happy → unhappy.** (felice → infelice) **un-** e **dis-** significano «non», il resto non cambia: **unkind** (scortese), **unlucky** (sfortunato); **disagree** (non essere d'accordo), **dislike** (non gradire), **dishonest** (disonesto). **disappear** (sparire) è un'altra parola con **dis-**. Quale va bene lo impari con la parola.
say.en: **happy → unhappy.** **un-** and **dis-** say not, and nothing else changes: **unkind**, **unlucky**; **disagree**, **dislike**, **dishonest**. **disappear** is one more word with **dis-**. Which one it takes, you learn with the word.

say.sl: **possible → impossible.** (mogoč → nemogoč) Besede z **in-** ga spremenijo: **im-** pred p in m: **impolite** (nevljuden), **impatient** (nestrpen); **il-** pred l: **illegal** (nezakonit); **ir-** pred r: **irregular** (nereden). Druge ostanejo **in-**: **incorrect** (napačen). **re-** pomeni »znova«: **rebuild** (obnoviti); **mis-** narobe: **misunderstand** (narobe razumeti); **over-** preveč: **oversleep** (predolgo spati).
say.de: **possible → impossible.** (möglich → unmöglich) Wörter mit **in-** ändern es: **im-** vor p und m: **impolite** (unhöflich), **impatient** (ungeduldig); **il-** vor l: **illegal** (illegal); **ir-** vor r: **irregular** (unregelmäßig). Andere bleiben bei **in-**: **incorrect** (falsch). **re-** bedeutet „wieder“: **rebuild** (wieder aufbauen); **mis-** falsch: **misunderstand** (missverstehen); **over-** zu viel: **oversleep** (verschlafen).
say.it: **possible → impossible.** (possibile → impossibile) Le parole con **in-** lo cambiano: **im-** prima di p e m: **impolite** (scortese), **impatient** (impaziente); il- prima di l: **illegal** (illegale); **ir-** prima di r: **irregular** (irregolare). Altre restano **in-**: **incorrect** (sbagliato). **re-** significa «di nuovo»: **rebuild** (ricostruire); **mis-** male: **misunderstand** (fraintendere); **over-** troppo: **oversleep** (dormire troppo).
say.en: **possible → impossible.** Words that take **in-** change it: **im-** before p and m: **impolite**, **impatient**; **il-** before l: **illegal**; **ir-** before r: **irregular**. Others stay **in-**: **incorrect**. **re-** says again: **rebuild**; **mis-** wrongly: **misunderstand**; **over-** too much: **oversleep**.

examples.en: It's impossible to see the path.
examples.de: Man kann den Weg unmöglich sehen.

say.sl: **happy → happiness.** (srečen → sreča) Samostalnik iz pridevnika: **-ness**, y postane i: **kindness**, **darkness**, **illness**. Iz glagola: **-ment**: **agreement**; **-tion**, **-sion**: **information**, **invitation**, **decision** (iz decide). Kdo to dela: **-er**, **-or**: **farmer**, **teacher**, **visitor**, **sailor**.
say.de: **happy → happiness.** (glücklich → Glück) Ein Nomen aus einem Adjektiv: **-ness**, aus y wird i: **kindness**, **darkness**, **illness**. Aus einem Verb: **-ment**: **agreement**; **-tion**, **-sion**: **information**, **invitation**, **decision** (von decide). Wer es tut: **-er**, **-or**: **farmer**, **teacher**, **visitor**, **sailor**.
say.it: **happy → happiness.** (felice → felicità) Un nome da un aggettivo: **-ness**, y diventa i: **kindness**, **darkness**, **illness**. Da un verbo: **-ment**: **agreement**; **-tion**, **-sion**: **information**, **invitation**, **decision** (da decide). Chi lo fa: **-er**, **-or**: **farmer**, **teacher**, **visitor**, **sailor**.
say.en: **happy → happiness.** A noun from an adjective: **-ness**, y becoming i: **kindness**, **darkness**, **illness**. From a verb: **-ment**: **agreement**; **-tion**, **-sion**: **information**, **invitation**, **decision** (from decide). Who does it: **-er**, **-or**: **farmer**, **teacher**, **visitor**, **sailor**.

explain.en:

- kind → kindness · happy → happiness

say.sl: **care → careful, careless.** (previden, nepreviden) **-ful** pomeni »z«, **-less** »brez«: **useful** (koristen), **useless** (neuporaben), **hopeful** (poln upanja). V **-ful** je en l. **beautiful** (iz beauty): y postane i. Druge končnice: **dangerous** (iz danger), **famous** (fame), **rainy** (rain), **natural** (nature), **comfortable** (comfort).
say.de: **care → careful, careless.** (vorsichtig, unvorsichtig) **-ful** bedeutet „mit“, **-less** „ohne“: **useful** (nützlich), **useless** (nutzlos), **hopeful** (hoffnungsvoll). In **-ful** steht ein l. **beautiful** (von beauty): aus y wird i. Andere Endungen: **dangerous** (von danger), **famous** (fame), **rainy** (rain), **natural** (nature), **comfortable** (comfort).
say.it: **care → careful, careless.** (prudente, sbadato) **-ful** significa «con», **-less** «senza»: **useful** (utile), **useless** (inutile), **hopeful** (fiducioso). In **-ful** c'è una l. **beautiful** (da beauty): y diventa i. Altri suffissi: **dangerous** (da danger), **famous** (fame), **rainy** (rain), **natural** (nature), **comfortable** (comfort).
say.en: **care → careful, careless.** **-ful** says with, **-less** without: **useful**, **useless**, **hopeful**. One l in **-ful**. **beautiful** (from beauty): y becomes i. Other endings: **dangerous** (from danger), **famous** (fame), **rainy** (rain), **natural** (nature), **comfortable** (comfort).

say.sl: **wide → widen.** (širok → razširiti) Glagol iz pridevnika: **-en**: **shorten**, **widen**. **-ise**: **realise** (iz real; prav je tudi -ize). Prislov: **-ly**: **careful → carefully**, **happy → happily**. Cela družina: **succeed** (uspeti), **success** (uspeh), **successful** (uspešen), **unsuccessful** (neuspešen).
say.de: **wide → widen.** (breit → verbreitern) Ein Verb aus einem Adjektiv: **-en**: **shorten**, **widen**. **-ise**: **realise** (von real; auch -ize ist richtig). Ein Adverb: **-ly**: **careful → carefully**, **happy → happily**. Eine ganze Familie: **succeed** (Erfolg haben), **success** (Erfolg), **successful** (erfolgreich), **unsuccessful** (erfolglos).
say.it: **wide → widen.** (largo → allargare) Un verbo da un aggettivo: **-en**: **shorten**, **widen**. **-ise**: **realise** (da real; va bene anche -ize). Un avverbio: **-ly**: **careful → carefully**, **happy → happily**. Una famiglia intera: **succeed** (riuscire), **success** (successo), **successful** (di successo), **unsuccessful** (senza successo).
say.en: **wide → widen.** A verb from an adjective: **-en**: **shorten**, **widen**. **-ise**: **realise** (from real; -ize is right too). An adverb: **-ly**: **careful → carefully**, **happy → happily**. A whole family: **succeed**, **success**, **successful**, **unsuccessful**.

say.sl: Poglej okoli vrzeli: sam za **a**, **the** samostalnik; pred samostalnikom pridevnik: **a useful tool**; z glagolom prislov: **She spoke quietly.** Potem vprašaj: ali ima stavek nikalen pomen? Je več ljudi, torej množina? **The darkness of the morning soon gave way to sunshine.** (Jutranja tema se je kmalu umaknila soncu.) Tako sprašuje izpit B2 First: beseda v oklepaju, ena vrzel.
say.de: Schau dir an, was um die Lücke steht: allein nach **a**, **the** ein Nomen; vor einem Nomen ein Adjektiv: **a useful tool**; beim Verb ein Adverb: **She spoke quietly.** Dann frag dich: Ist der Satz verneint gemeint? Sind es mehrere, also Plural? **The darkness of the morning soon gave way to sunshine.** (Die Dunkelheit des Morgens wich bald dem Sonnenschein.) So fragt die Prüfung B2 First: ein Wort in Klammern, eine Lücke.
say.it: Guarda che cosa c'è intorno allo spazio: da solo dopo **a**, **the** un nome; davanti a un nome un aggettivo: **a useful tool**; con un verbo un avverbio: **She spoke quietly.** Poi chiediti: la frase è negativa? Sono più di uno, quindi plurale? **The darkness of the morning soon gave way to sunshine.** (Il buio del mattino ha presto lasciato il posto al sole.) Così chiede l'esame B2 First: una parola tra parentesi, uno spazio.
say.en: Look around the gap: alone after **a**, **the** a noun; before a noun an adjective: **a useful tool**; with a verb an adverb: **She spoke quietly.** Then ask: does the sentence mean not? Are there several, so a plural? **The darkness of the morning soon gave way to sunshine.** This is how the B2 First exam asks it: a word in brackets, one gap.

exercises.text: Last Saturday's show was a great ___ (succeed). Everyone was ___ (hope) about the weather, and the ___ (dark) of the morning soon gave way to sunshine. Thanks to the ___ (kind) of Mrs Birkett, nobody went hungry. The only ___ (disappoint) was the bus, which was as ___ (regular) as ever. Many ___ (visit) stayed till evening.

translation.sl: Sobotna razstava je bila velik uspeh. Vsi so upali na lepo vreme in jutranja tema se je kmalu umaknila soncu. Po zaslugi prijaznosti gospe Birkett nihče ni ostal lačen. Razočaral je le avtobus, ki je vozil neredno kot vedno. Veliko obiskovalcev je ostalo do večera.
translation.de: Die Schau am letzten Samstag war ein großer Erfolg. Alle hofften auf gutes Wetter, und die Dunkelheit des Morgens wich bald dem Sonnenschein. Dank der Freundlichkeit von Mrs Birkett blieb niemand hungrig. Die einzige Enttäuschung war der Bus, unregelmäßig wie immer. Viele Besucher blieben bis zum Abend.
translation.it: La mostra di sabato scorso è stata un gran successo. Tutti speravano nel bel tempo, e il buio del mattino ha presto lasciato il posto al sole. Grazie alla gentilezza della signora Birkett, nessuno è rimasto a stomaco vuoto. L'unica delusione è stato l'autobus, irregolare come sempre. Molti visitatori sono rimasti fino a sera.
translation.en: Last Saturday's show was a great success. Everyone was hopeful about the weather, and the darkness of the morning soon gave way to sunshine. Thanks to the kindness of Mrs Birkett, nobody went hungry. The only disappointment was the bus, which was as irregular as ever. Many visitors stayed till evening.

exercises.text: I'd like to thank the ___ (farm) who found my dog. In that fog it was almost ___ (possible) to see the road, but he knew the way. He is a ___ (care) driver, and he brought us home ___ (safe). The road is ___ (danger) at night. When will the council ___ (wide) it?

translation.sl: {m:Rad|f:Rada} bi se {m:zahvalil|f:zahvalila} kmetu, ki je našel mojega psa. V tisti megli ceste skoraj ni bilo mogoče videti, a on je poznal pot. Je previden voznik in varno nas je pripeljal domov. Cesta je ponoči nevarna. Kdaj jo bo občina razširila?
translation.de: Ich möchte dem Bauern danken, der meinen Hund gefunden hat. In dem Nebel war die Straße fast nicht zu sehen, aber er kannte den Weg. Er ist ein vorsichtiger Fahrer und brachte uns sicher nach Hause. Die Straße ist nachts gefährlich. Wann verbreitert die Gemeinde sie?
translation.it: Vorrei ringraziare il contadino che ha trovato il mio cane. Con quella nebbia era quasi impossibile vedere la strada, ma lui la conosceva. È un guidatore prudente e ci ha riportati a casa sani e salvi. La strada è pericolosa di notte. Quando la allargherà il comune?
translation.en: I'd like to thank the farmer who found my dog. In that fog it was almost impossible to see the road, but he knew the way. He is a careful driver, and he brought us home safely. The road is dangerous at night. When will the council widen it?

exercises.text: It was a ___ (beauty) morning, and the ___ (visit) from Keswick walked up to the tarn. One man was very ___ (polite) to Mr Tyson and left all his rubbish by the water. That was ___ (legal), and Mr Tyson told him so. “I'm sorry for the ___ (understand),” the man said ___ (quiet).

translation.sl: Bilo je lepo jutro in obiskovalci iz Keswicka so se povzpeli do jezerca. Neki moški je bil zelo nevljuden do gospoda Tysona in je vse smeti pustil ob vodi. To je bilo nezakonito in gospod Tyson mu je to povedal. »Oprostite za nesporazum,« je tiho rekel moški.
translation.de: Es war ein schöner Morgen, und die Besucher aus Keswick stiegen zum Bergsee hinauf. Ein Mann war sehr unhöflich zu Mr Tyson und ließ seinen ganzen Müll am Wasser liegen. Das war illegal, und Mr Tyson sagte es ihm. „Das Missverständnis tut mir leid“, sagte der Mann leise.
translation.it: Era un bel mattino, e i visitatori di Keswick sono saliti al laghetto. Un uomo è stato molto scortese con il signor Tyson e ha lasciato tutti i rifiuti vicino all'acqua. Era illegale, e il signor Tyson glielo ha detto. «Mi scusi per il malinteso», ha detto piano l'uomo.
translation.en: It was a beautiful morning, and the visitors from Keswick walked up to the tarn. One man was very impolite to Mr Tyson and left all his rubbish by the water. That was illegal, and Mr Tyson told him so. “I'm sorry for the misunderstanding,” the man said quietly.
